title: An autonomous GPS-denied unmanned vehicle platform based on binocular vision for planetary exploration
authors: Qin M.; Wan X.; Shao Y.-Y.; Li S.-Y.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
